author: Pallas, 1776
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 염전, 논, 갯벌, 강 하구, 물웅덩이

months.note: 4월 중순~5월 하순과 7월 하순~11월 초에 지나가고 겨울에도 드물게 기록되며, 번식지에서는 6월 하순~7월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 국내를 흔하게 지나가는 나그네새로, 염전·논·갯벌·강 하구에서 무리를 이루어 지낸다. 서해안 염전 지대와 그 주변의 논, 물웅덩이에서 자주 보이며, 민물도요와 섞여 다니는 일이 많다. 알 4개를 낳아 암수가 함께 품는다. 시베리아 동북부에서 번식하고 가을에 남쪽으로 내려가 인도·미얀마·말레이시아·필리핀·오스트레일리아 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: rufous head, neck and upper breast (breeding)
white around the base of the bill
grey-brown upperparts with thin dark shaft streaks (winter)

young: 어린새는 등이 어두운 갈색이고 깃 가장자리가 적갈색이다.

similar.how: 작은도요는 부리가 조금 더 길고 가늘며 다리가 길고, 여름깃에서 턱과 멱이 희어 얼굴부터 멱까지 적갈색인 좀도요와 다르다.

art.subject: Red-necked Stint (Calidris ruficollis), adult in breeding plumage as seen on Korean west-coast salt pans and paddies in May: face, throat, neck and upper breast plain, unstreaked rufous-orange to brick-red, with a small whitish patch at the base of the bill and a whitish chin; crown rufous streaked black; mantle and scapulars rufous with black centres; wing coverts and tertials contrasting greyish with dark centres; a band of small dark spots below the rufous on the breast sides; rest of the underparts clean white. Bill short and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: feeding in a small flock on wet mud, picking quickly at the surface
art.scene: Korean west-coast salt pans and nearby paddies during spring migration, shallow pools and wet mud; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (May), side view standing: unstreaked rufous face, throat, neck and upper breast, whitish around the bill base, rufous back with black-centred feathers, greyish wing coverts, white belly, short black bill and black legs

adult winter plumage, side view standing: pale grey upperparts with thin dark shaft streaks, whitish supercilium, grey patches on the breast sides, all-white underparts, long wings extending beyond the tail

juvenile (August–September), side view standing: dark-brown-centred back and scapulars with rufous fringes, whitish lines on the mantle, greyish wing coverts with pale fringes, faint buff breast sides
art.build: Tiny, plump stint, 15cm, about the length of a sparrow, with a horizontally elongated, tapering rear because the long wings extend clearly beyond the tail at rest. Short neck, rounded head. Bill black, short, straight and rather stubby with a slightly blunt tip, a little shorter than the head. Legs short and black. Feeds with rapid running and pecking. In flight a narrow white wing-bar and a black centre to the rump and tail with white sides.
avoid: Do not paint greenish or yellowish legs — those belong to Long-toed and Temminck's Stints; Red-necked Stint has black legs.
Do not give it a long or drooping bill (Dunlin) or a long neck.
Do not streak the rufous throat and neck; in breeding plumage they are plain rufous.
Do not show any rufous on winter birds; they are pale grey and white.
